Natural skin texture, authentic diverse facial features, believable relaxed posture and anatomically correct hands resting simply, editorial photographic realism, subtle grain, no airbrushing, no plastic AI faces, no exaggerated grin, no handshake, no pointing at camera, no corporate stock cliche, no cinematic drama.
